basic_info.description: Price Reduced! Developers or End-Users! This is a fabulous entitled SFH project which offers developers and end-users a once in a lifetime opportunity to build a FULLY ENTITLED lovely view home of your dreams in the prime location of Noe Valley! Designed by Hood Thomas Architects this home will have a magnificent master suite looking out onto water views, plus two bedrooms and a bathroom on this top floor. The main floor has a large formal living room along with an open kitchen/dining area opening onto a flat backyard. Downstairs, on the garage level, offers a family/media room, a laundry room and mud room. Don't miss this rare opportunity to build this masterpiece in the unique and desirable cul-de-sac location in the heart of Noe Valley.
